story:
Unne is the youngest who sits at Cronk's fire. The tree-clan of Faraheim keeps the right of fire, the law that the chief alone holds the clan's flame, and round Cronk sit those he has chosen: Trude the hand that chose, Uppsala whom three accounts explain three ways, and Unne, who is the lowest in years and the last to be given a place, and who tends the fire while the others talk.

The tree-clan says Unne was given the place because she was the only one at the fire who never asked for it. Solvi of Hagall, who traps near the tradklan's trunks, says she carries the clan's coal from the fire to the clay pot when Cronk sleeps, and that if the right of fire ever passes from Cronk without bloodshed, it will pass through Unne's hands. When strangers come to the fire she fights beside the others, and when Cronk rises, the whole fire rises with him.
legend: Unne is a level 41 tradklan at Cronk's fire in Faraheim, next to Trude and Uppsala, and she's in Cronk's pack: if Cronk gets aggro, every CronkBaf member within 2,500 joins, Unne included, so treat her as part of Cronk's fight. She's far lower than the medicine men and darters round her (52-56). Unne is in the CronkBaf pack: if Cronk is pulled, every CronkBaf member within range comes too, Unne included.
